newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Afrox sees real profit growth in year ahead.
newsitem.headline: Afrox sees real profit growth in year ahead.

text.p: Engineering group African Oxygen Ltd said on Thursday it expected to register real earnings growth in the coming financial year.
The company posted attributable earnings of 181 million rand in the year to September 30, a 19 percent improvement on the previous year's results.
"Afrox, with its strong market position, serving a diversity of markets, is well placed to respond to any changes in the markets in which it operates," the company said in a statement.
The company focuses on gas, welding and healthcare businesses, which it said were expected to perform better in the coming year.
"Given no meaningful deterioration in economic conditions, another year of real growth is anticipated."
